decision_conditions: Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority (before the extension is occupied).

Condition : 5 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the eastern or western walls of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 6 - The extension [building] hereby permitted shall not be occupied at any time other than for purposes ancillary to the residential use of the dwelling known as 53 Elmer Gardebns Isleworth.
(Reason.  The accommodation is considered unsuitable for occupation by a separate person or household not related to the occupiers of the single family dwelling to which it is attached, and such use would have a detrimental effect upon the character of the neighbourhood.  To accord with policyH.3.4 Conversions of Houses to Flats of the Hounslow UDP).
description: Erection of a single storey rear extension, first floor side extension and rear roof extension to existing dwellinghouse.
